description: This plot illustrates the growth of vocabulary size over a number of iterations for three languages: Spanish, Korean, and Japanese, alongside an unlabeled reference line. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Iterations" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Vocabulary Size" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5000, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1000. The plot contains four main solid lines without markers, three of which are accompanied by fainter, lighter-colored lines of the same hue indicating variance. A solid grey line represents a constant, linear increase from a vocabulary size of 0 at 0 iterations to exactly 5000 at 500 iterations. The line for Spanish is solid blue and shows a steady upward trend, starting at a vocabulary size of 0 at 0 iterations and reaching approximately 3300 at 500 iterations. The line for Japanese is solid green, also starting at 0 and increasing steadily to end at approximately 3200 at 500 iterations. The line for Korean is solid orange, beginning at 0 and rising steadily to finish at approximately 3000 at 500 iterations.
